note: urlToAction now computes one target range (default when both params absent) and does a single compare-then-setDates.
Removes both duplicated in-loop snapshot checks; unclassified cohorts are instead read once from the database after the run. Equivalent de-duplication, different approach.
Feeds before+after groups into the per-row logic for name resolution and tweaks rollout display; name caches still live in per-row keyed logic.
Deletes the duplicate timeslots branch from the generic function type inference.
Makes the eval workflow manual-dispatch only, dropping PR label triggers; it still runs in GitHub Actions rather than a separate app.
DEFAULT_MODEL is now parsed from a new LLMA_SUMMARIZATION_MODEL setting, making rollback a config change.
Switches BackfillRunAttempt to @frozen from posthog.dataclasses and drops the dataclasses import.
Simplifies _normalize_uuid and merges the email match query into the uuid lookup; no shared per-id-type normalization helper is introduced.
Renames Credential/MountedCredentials to Secret/MountedSecrets across the integration service and docs.
Candidate query now uses the hogql tag and api.queryHogQL with queryParams; row tuple casts replaced by column-indexed access.
Extracts _drop_echoed_v2_fields and moves the soft-delete active=False into validate, leaving _reject_unsupported_v2_operations as a pure check.
Imports from the access_control facade, uses split_restricted_property_names, drops PropertyDefinition import and the tach leak entry.
Extracts _populate_static_cohort holding the claim/retry/finalize protocol; both tasks delegate with an insert function and log prefix.
Hoists list filter params into EXPERIMENT_LIST_FILTER_PARAMETERS used by list and matching_ids; regenerates clients and updates Experiments.tsx.
Computes is_basic_list once at the top and merges the experiment_set prefetch and last_error_code annotation into one block.
Adds SidebarBulkActionFooter bundling the bar, confirm dialog and snapshot state; ChannelSidebar and SidebarMenu both render it.
Renames the reconcile metrics label from guard to kind in the stream processor, cohort-core loader and related emitters.
Replaces depth gauge with held events/bytes gauges on revoke; ledger in the order sentinel is not made optional.
Replaces the div role=button draft card with a LemonBanner whose action button resumes, discard button beside it, and adds explicit void return types.
Adds a shared _sanitize_context helper with caps and coerce flag; validate_traits and validate_session_context delegate to it.
